outcomes.vision: Moved by the Spirit of the Risen Christ, La Consolacion University Philippines, envisions itself to become a catalyst for the wholistic transformational development of Catholic Augustinian Marian graduates rooted in Gospel values.

mission.lead: To achieve the above vision, LCUP commits itself to generate and make available to its Augustinian Marian students, programs and services that will make them:
items: exhibit academic and technical competence in their respective areas of discipline in the local and international environment;
demonstrate their knowledge, critical thinking and creativity by exploring the various avenues of learning and searching for truth;
manifest their willingness to serve specially the marginalized sector of our society;
demonstrate productivity in various areas of learning as responsible citizens of the society; and
live the Gospel values in the varied aspects of their personal and professional lives

pos.text: Articulate and discuss the latest developments in the specific field of practice;
Effectively communicate orally and in writing using both English and Filipino;
Work effectively and independently in multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural teams;
Act in recognition of professional, social ethical responsibility;
Preserve and promote “Filipino historical and cultural heritage;
Analyze complex problems, and identify and define the computing requirements needed to design and appropriate solution;
Apply computing and other knowledge domains to address real-world problems;
Design and develop computing solutions using a system-level perspective;

description.t:
This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It
aims to foster a strong foundation in logical formulation techniques essential for programming, while promoting the
development of good coding practices. Students will be taught the fundamentals of Java programming and explore
significant real-world applications. 
In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming   Christo-centric Catholic professionals , the
course integrates   Marian Augustinian values   in each lesson, ensuring that students not only achieve intellectual growth
but also cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute
positively to society, embodying   community, humility, and love of service , as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary
and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both
technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

clos.statement: Define and analyze the computing requirements needed for an effective solution that is essential for developing holistic and impactful solutions.

clos.title: CLO 2
clos.statement:  Incorporate ethical standards and social responsibility into technical designs, ensuring that solutions serve the common good, in line with Marian and Augustinian principles of truth and compassion. 

clos.title: CLO 3
clos.statement: Collaborate effectively within multi-disciplinary and culturally diverse teams to develop Java- based programming solutions that address social challenges, demonstrating social responsibility and cultural sensitivity.

clos.title: CLO 4
clos.statement: Demonstrate the Filipino- Catholic Augustinian Spirituality through value webbing.
